rows.definition: ProgressWitnessedAt is the resume watchdog MTTR timestamp proving a resumed session made independent progress after launch, derived from ledger progress, new turns, or a commit witness.
rows.distinction: It is the progress-evidence timestamp for watchdog recovery, not the resume launch timestamp ResumedAt and not a generic witness verdict.

rows.definition: renderLiveMonitorOutputReason renders the repo-guard refusal text for attempts to read a live Monitor output path before the stream has materialized as a ready file.
rows.distinction: It renders a live-monitor read refusal message, not a general renderReason helper and not the monitor task-id classifier.
